_doc: UNDERTOW character canon — machine-readable. This file is the single source of truth for character identity. Any art pipeline, human or automated, MUST read this before generating a character. Human-readable rationale lives in UNDERTOW-VISDEV-BRIEFS.md and UNDERTOW-ART-PROTOCOL.md.

no_breathing_apparatus.rule: No scuba tanks, oxygen tanks, regulators, rebreathers, or dive masks on ANY character in ANY frame.
no_breathing_apparatus.why: The entire power system is breath-hold freediving. Apparatus erases the premise.

no_costumes.rule: No capes, cloaks, flowing fabric, or superhero costuming. These are athletes.

reference_required.rule: A character may never be generated from a text description alone. The character's element_id MUST be embedded in the prompt as <<<element_id>>>, or the approved plate supplied as an image reference.
reference_required.why: Text-only prompts default to a generic pale figure. This erased Kai three consecutive times on 2026-07-25 before the rule existed.

visual_verification_required.rule: Every generated character asset MUST be visually inspected against this canon BEFORE being shown to the creator or committed. Off-model output is discarded, never presented as an option.
visual_verification_required.why: The creator should never be the quality filter.

element_source_must_show_baseline_state.rule: A character element MUST include at least one BASELINE reference: neutral daylight, plain background, character in their ordinary un-powered state. An element learns everything in its source plate as identity — it cannot tell a permanent trait from a temporary one.
element_source_must_show_baseline_state.why: Discovered twice on 2026-07-30. (1) Luna's element, built solely from a violet-twilight underwater plate, rendered her skin blue-lavender on a sunlit pool deck — it had learned the LIGHTING as skin tone. (2) Kai's element, built solely from the submerged pool-floor plate, carried the deep-blue Undertow eye-glow and water-cast teal hair onto a dry pool deck — it had learned a POWERED STATE as his face. The second is the worse failure: the glow is the visual tell that the Undertow is surfacing, so showing it on dry land breaks the power system itself.
element_source_must_show_baseline_state.how: Generate a baseline plate first — flat neutral daylight, plain grey background, no environmental cast, no active power, no story-state effects. Create the element with that reference FIRST and any atmospheric or powered plate second.
applies_to: environmental colour cast (lighting learned as skin tone)
state-dependent traits (eye glow, aura, transformation learned as permanent features)
wet/dry hair and any other condition-specific rendering

kai.retired_reason: v1 was built solely from the submerged pool-floor plate, where the deep-blue Undertow eye-glow and water-cast teal hair are canon-correct. The element learned that POWERED STATE as his permanent face and carried the glow onto a dry pool deck in every crew render. v2 supplies a neutral dry-land baseline first (dark brown eyes, blue-black hair) plus the submerged plate second.

identity.heritage: Mixed Black — Japanese father (Daigo Isozaki), Jamaican mother
identity.hair: tightly-coiled blue-black, worn a little overgrown, falls toward his eyes; never straightened. NEVER teal, green or turquoise — that is water light, not hair colour
identity.eyes: ordinary dark brown on dry land. The deep-blue Undertow glow appears ONLY when he is submerged — it is the visual tell that the power is surfacing, so it must never appear on a pool deck, in a classroom, or anywhere dry
identity.build: lean, slightly under-muscled — a body that hasn't been allowed to train
identity.signature_prop: shell-cord bracelet that was his late mother's; never removed

wardrobe: school uniform with sleeves pulled over hands
forbidden: blue or luminous eyes on dry land
kai.notes: His heritage is SHOWN, never stated in dialogue. Off-model = discarded, never shown for approval.

luna.retired_reason: v1 was built from a single underwater violet-twilight plate. The element baked the environmental colour cast in as her SKIN TONE — she rendered blue-lavender on a sunlit pool deck. v2 is built on a neutral-daylight baseline reference.
luna.known_gap: The v2 element currently holds ONLY the neutral baseline plate — the violet-twilight underwater plate did not attach on creation. Recorded rather than hidden. Renders are correct, but her underwater signature look must be carried by prompt text until a second reference is added.
